body: Our 2-Pocket Sports Leggings are designed for people with diabetes who want to wear their insulin pump securely, discreetly and comfortably during sport and everyday life. The leggings have two deep side pockets, ideally positioned to hold your pump steady. A discreet opening on the inside of the pocket lets you route the infusion tube neatly, so nothing dangles and the risk of snagging is reduced.

Whether you walk, run, do yoga or simply have a busy day, these leggings give you freedom of movement and peace of mind. The soft, breathable and stretchy fabric moves with you, and the second pocket is handy for your phone or keys.

insuline-organizer.seo_desc: Compact 3D-printed holder for 1 insulin pen and 5 needles. 16.5 × 4.8 × 2.8 cm, made of PLA. In black, white or green.
body: Often on the go and want to carry your insulin pen and needles safely and neatly? This 3D-printed insulin pen holder has room for 1 insulin pen and 5 needles, so you always have everything at hand without loose items rattling around your bag.
The holder has two round openings (both 2 cm in diameter) that hold your pen and needles firmly. At 16.5 cm high, 2.8 cm deep and 4.8 cm wide, it easily fits in a handbag, backpack or pocket.
The holder is made of PLA (polylactic acid), a bioplastic made from renewable raw materials such as corn and sugar cane. It is sturdy enough for daily use and lightweight.
Do not expose to direct sunlight or high temperatures for long periods
Store dry: PLA can absorb moisture and become more brittle
Do not overload: hard drops or bending can cause cracks

faq: General
What should I do if there is a problem with my order?
Contact our customer service at info@diabeticswear.com and we will solve it together.
How can I give feedback?
We appreciate your feedback! Send an email to info@diabeticswear.com.
Product information
How do I know which size I need?
Our t-shirt and tank top pages include a size chart. They run large; we recommend ordering one size smaller than usual. Not sure? Contact us for advice.
Will my insulin pump fit in the pockets?
The pockets fit most common insulin pumps. Not sure? Email us your pump model and we will advise you.
Are all products in stock?
If an item is temporarily out of stock, you can still order it. We will ship it as soon as it is available again.
How do I keep my product in good condition?
Follow the care instructions on the label in the product.
Ordering and delivery
Where do you ship to?
We currently ship to the Netherlands and Belgium.
What are the shipping costs?
Within the Netherlands shipping is free from €30; below that it costs €4.25. To Belgium shipping is free from €75; below that it costs €5.25.
How long does delivery take?
We aim to deliver your order within 2-3 working days.
Can I track my order?
Once your order has shipped, you will receive a tracking number by email.
Payment and returns
Which payment methods do you accept?
iDEAL, Bancontact, Klarna and bank transfer.
How do I return an item?
You can return products within 14 days of receipt. Email info@diabeticswear.com with the reason for the return and we will send you the next steps.
When will I get my money back?
Once we have received and processed your return, we refund the amount within 5 working days.
What are the return costs?
Return shipping is at your own expense, unless the item was incorrectly delivered or defective.
reviews: The shirts are in one word AMAZING!! I have used the shirt both privately and at work, where the pump always used to be in the way. I no longer have this problem. No more pump in the way when getting in and out of the car.

After 2 days of wearing it I am enthusiastic! Inserting the catheter took some getting used to, but that gets easier as the shirt becomes softer. During housework and jogging my pump stayed firmly and safely in place. Made of sturdy fabric.
I am so happy with this T-shirt! It is super comfortable and perfectly designed for wearing my insulin pump discreetly. A real recommendation for anyone who wears an insulin pump every day.

I am satisfied with the product, but the neckline is quite high and sticks out above other clothing for me as a woman. The pockets are roomy, so the pump moves a bit. It is nice that there is a pocket on both sides, the Velcro works well and the fabric is comfortable.

The fabric is quite thick, which makes it less suitable to wear under other clothes. As a stomach sleeper I find the pockets on the front awkward for sleeping. The Velcro also sometimes catches on my clothes.
The biker shorts fit really well. The fabric feels nice, which is pleasant in this warm weather. The shorts do ride up a little, so next time I might order a size larger.
